source_snapshot.procedure: Collect BF3 SDR elist and sensor list through host-local in-band and BMC lanplus out-of-band paths.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor names, descriptions and readings in both views match SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; substitutes devlink firmware/board information and wrong packages for all four required ipmitool reads.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restore dual-path sensor coverage, secure BMC credentials, exact sensor matrix, units/ranges and complete evidence.

old_problem: DeepSeek reviewed a different devlink firmware query and omitted every required SDR/sensor command. The source also lacked a BF3-to-BMC/sensor mapping, secure credential handling, canonical IDs/names/units/ranges, freshness and rules for in-band versus OOB discrepancies.
disposition_reason: IPMI SDR and sensor listing are standard read-only mechanisms and the four source views unambiguously define coverage. ED-03 permits the BMC endpoint and signed sensor matrix as project configuration; ED-15 prevents PASS without expected readings/ranges, and ED-17 requires existing BMC/SEL evidence to be preserved rather than cleared.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row387 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2980 and unique variant.
Interpreted the source's `IB` from its local ipmitool commands as host in-band IPMI, distinct from the lanplus out-of-band BMC path and not as InfiniBand networking.
Retained all four raw views—SDR elist and sensor list over both paths—plus names, descriptions, readings, 10-minute allocations and SPEC comparison; devlink is not accepted as a substitute.
Directly read Compatibility row388 baseline and the actual next formal queue row389, then verified row389 manifest identity; no IPMI/BMC/DUT command ran.

test_case.test_name: BF3 dual-path IPMI SDR and live-sensor conformance
test_case.purpose: Verify the complete BlueField 3 sensor inventory, metadata, status and live readings are present and mutually consistent through host in-band IPMI and the mapped BMC out-of-band lanplus path and conform to the signed sensor specification.
required_package: BF3 model/serial/PSID/slot and BMC endpoint/firmware mapping
Canonical SDR record IDs, sensor numbers, names, entity IDs/descriptions, units, expected presence/optional rules, status and numeric ranges/tolerance/freshness
Pinned ipmitool with supported local system interface and lanplus cipher/TLS policy
Secure non-logged credential broker or protected environment-file/FD mechanism; no command-line password evidence
Timestamp synchronization, raw evidence destination and cross-path normalization/equivalence rules
test_case.test_command: Preserve SEL and system evidence; using the verified BMC endpoint and secure secret injection, capture complete unfiltered `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list` output through the host-local in-band path and again through BMC lanplus. Only after retaining raw tables, map approved BF3 sensor IDs/names, normalize units/status/timestamps and compare presence, metadata and readings across both paths and against SPEC.
test_case.expected_result: Every required BF3 SDR/sensor appears exactly once in both access paths with approved ID/name/entity/description/unit/status; readings are fresh, numerically within signed range/tolerance and equivalent across paths under the declared normalization; optional absences follow SPEC and no new BMC/platform anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all four complete raw tables, target/endpoint provenance and a field-by-field signed sensor-matrix comparison. A grep hit, devlink output, plausible temperature or one path alone cannot pass; missing, stale, duplicate, unmapped or divergent data is reported for engineer verdict.
safety_gate: Verify BMC endpoint and BF3 physical/sensor mapping before collection
Never expose BMC passwords in arguments, shell history, process lists, logs or records
Read only; preserve existing SEL/system logs and capture full tables before filtering
Stop on endpoint/cipher/authentication ambiguity, transport errors or unexpected sensor state; do not clear, reset or retry automatically
expected_evidence: BF3/BMC identity, firmware and signed sensor matrix
Credential-access audit with all secrets redacted
Four timestamped raw outputs: in-band SDR, in-band sensor, OOB SDR and OOB sensor
Preserved SEL/BMC/platform logs and anomaly list
test_case.recovery: The approved operation is read-only. On authentication, transport or sensor anomaly, preserve evidence and stop without retry or log clear; revoke/rotate exposed credentials if necessary and use the BMC owner runbook for any endpoint or sensor-service recovery.
